unverified: Field shapes were checked against the ElevenLabs OpenAPI schema (api.elevenlabs.io/openapi.json) on 2026-10-22; see step0-results.md for what the live API kept after a GET.
built_in_tools.transfer_to_agent is a SystemToolConfig: params.system_tool_type and params.transfers[] sit directly in params (the earlier params.transfer_to_agent.transfers nesting was wrong).

custom_llm.request_headers values: plain string, {secret_id}, {variable_name} or {env_var_label} (sync turns {secret_name} into {secret_id}). Whether {{call_id}} survives a transfer is a live step-0 check.
The post-call webhook is created by sync through POST /v1/workspace/webhooks (HMAC); the agent references it by post_call_webhook_id.
notes.transfer_rule_order: index = position in transfers[]: 0 front-desk, 1 consulting, 2 customer-desk
notes.staging: sync --env staging swaps the host https://arithim.com for the preview host (--staging-host).

prompt.prompt: Stub. The real instructions are sent by the custom LLM endpoint.

transfer_to_agent.name: transfer_to_agent
transfer_to_agent.description: Hand the call to a colleague when the caller's need clearly belongs to them.

transfers.condition: Partners, press, job seekers, vendors pitching, research or speaking requests, or anything unclear. Transfer back to Hannah (front desk).
The caller has a business problem, wants to buy a service, is unsure what they need, or is interested in AP Clerk. Transfer to Oliver (consulting and discovery).
An existing customer has a product problem, or the call is about an invoice in either direction, or a supplier or contract form. Transfer to Daniel.

end_call.name: end_call
end_call.description: End the call once the caller has said goodbye, asked to hang up, or the conversation is finished.

tts._voice_suggestions: Provisional staging pick: Alice (premade, clear British female). See arithim-ops/call-agent/voices.md for the shortlist.
tts._voice_note: eleven_v4_turbo: same first-byte latency as flash_v2_5 in a 2026-10-24 test (about 160-200 ms vs flash_v2 about 210-320 ms), newer and more natural; eleven_turbo_v2 is deprecated. The TTS schema has no style field. stability 0.4 and speed 1.0 for a less read-out delivery.
